Hi,

This is my attempt to recreate this post;
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/594d6d321da7043e

I have pretty much done it, but the problem is that the y axis isn't
giving me 'stacked' percentages...

> head(ao2m)

Im running this;

+ geom_area(colour="black") +
+ geom_linerange(aes(ymax=value), ymin=0, position="stack") +
+ scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:max(ao2m$variablen))
